goal.scope: One fixed global coordinate after stock GUIDED takeoff; stock speed; no custom flight code
goal.prediction: Approximately 5m north at unchanged 3m above-home height, then low-speed hold
goal.height_reference: above recorded home, not above sea level or terrain
goal.bounded_response: If rejected or not settled in 30s, retain failure and use qualified LAND path without bypass; wait for on-ground and disarmed before cleanup

first_sample_note: Offline sample comparison, not a reusable arrival detector or continuous-state guarantee
position_validity_rule: GPS fix>=3, EKF horizontal absolute-position flag16 and non-placeholder lat/lon; latest message state used. Derived north/east/error left blank for invalid rows. Raw coordinates retained.

cleanup.socket_check: lsof no matches, exit 1; TCP5760/5762/5763 and UDP5501/14550
cleanup.capture_stop: intentional Ctrl-C exit 130; JSONL flushed after each message

metric_method: Small-distance north/east projection from GLOBAL_POSITION_INT latitude/longitude; R=6378137m, east scaled by cos(reference latitude). Derived estimator error, not independent position accuracy.
limitations: One simulated run, not repeatability/hardware qualification.
Four MAVProxy startup parsing errors; cause uninvestigated.
No terrain loaded or terrain-relative capability qualified.
Stock FS_GCS_ENABLE=0; no lost-link handling qualified.
CSV latest mode/state are sampled with their ages; no continuous-state claim.
Unknown HOME_POSITION quaternion components are null in curated JSON; raw NaN observations remain locally.
Startup invalid/placeholder positions retained in CSV with validity flags; excluded from derived distance and plot.
No source modifications, speed tuning, perception or new automated tests.
Capture stopped intentionally via Ctrl-C, exit 130; console reconnect followed deliberate simulator termination.
